description: Defines the StreamAck class used for acknowledgment messages in streaming, including JSON serialization/deserialization, status management, and factory methods.

classes.name: StreamAck
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment message with element ID and status, capable of JSON serialization.

classes.name: StreamAck.Status
classes.description: Enumeration of possible acknowledgment statuses: SUCCESS, FAILURE, UNKNOWN.

methods.name: getElementId
methods.description: Returns the element ID associated with the acknowledgment.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the acknowledgment.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Factory method to create a successful acknowledgment for a given element ID.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Factory method to create a failure acknowledgment for a given element ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Private factory method to create a StreamAck with specified element ID and status.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a StreamAck instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the StreamAck to a JSON value.
